Data Vault methodology

Designed for scale, auditability and future data sources.

4Sight uses a Data Vault-aligned approach to simplify data ingestion, preserve traceability and support scalable enterprise analytics as new data sources are introduced.

  • ✓Source-system independent: consolidate data without locking the business into one operational system.
  • ✓Auditable by design: keep the lineage and history needed for confidence, compliance and reporting.
  • ✓Ready for AI: establish the governed data foundation required for ethical and reliable models.
